One way of showing the same data, such as a table, a chart, or a map.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for the portfolio page
sections.what: Brings in the page's header, backdrop, icons, the portfolio data and filter tools, and each view component the page can show.
sections.why: Needed so the page can load its data and switch between views.

sections.name: VIEWS
sections.title: The five portfolio views
sections.what: Defines the five portfolio views: Summary, Forecast, Dataset, Companies and Map. Each has a label, icon and page title, which the tab bar and page heading use.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps view names and titles in one place so the tabs and headings stay in step.
sections.watch_out: The view switch below has no fallback, so a new view added here but not there shows a blank page.

sections.name: Portfolio (part 1)
sections.title: Loading, errors and view selection
sections.what: Loads the portfolio data and applies the filters and industry scope. It then shows a loading screen, an error screen with retry, an empty-state message with a Clear filters button, or the view the reader picked.
sections.why: Likely reason: checks the loading and error states before drawing anything, so the views never run on missing data.
sections.watch_out: The Clear filters button resets only the listed filters, so any other active filter stays on.

sections.name: Portfolio (part 2)
sections.title: Page layout and view tabs
sections.what: Draws the page frame: the view tabs when no single industry is chosen, the page title, the count of projects in view, the filter bar, and the selected view. Line 77 is cut off in the packet, so its full contents are unclear.
sections.why: Likely reason: one shared page frame keeps the look consistent across all five views.
sections.watch_out: The header and view tabs appear only when no single industry is chosen, so industry pages look different from the main portfolio.

summary: This is the portfolio page, which shows the same set of projects through several views such as summary, forecast, dataset, companies, and map, with shared filters.
purpose: Lets a user look at a whole industry portfolio from different angles.
why: Reason not stated in the code. The views and shared filters suggest one place to explore the same data several ways.
how: The page loads the portfolio data, applies the chosen filters, and shows the selected view. It shows loading, error, or empty states. It also has a header and an industry backdrop.
inputs: Portfolio data from the portfolio library, the current view and filters from the portfolio state hook, and the industry context.
outputs: A rendered portfolio page with a filter bar and one of several views.
risks: Only the imports are visible here, so the view switching and error handling cannot be checked from this packet.
debug: If the page is blank, check the portfolio data hook and the loading and error states. If a view does not appear, check the view name in the portfolio state hook.
